gaps.gap: The records are researched candidates and have not received independent DDD or connector-owner adjudication.
gaps.closure_evidence: Signed review receipts by independent domain, security and connector owners.

gaps.gap: No representative deployed occurrence fixture and live capability probe exists for every class.
gaps.closure_evidence: At least two unrelated occurrence fixtures per class with fresh probe receipts and one negative fixture.

gaps.gap: The verification registry specifies tests but no adapter has published a complete conformance matrix here.
gaps.closure_evidence: Versioned connector declarations with executable conformance receipts for required tests.

gaps.gap: Evidence URLs and retrieval dates are recorded, but content digests, quoted clauses and archival snapshots are not yet pinned.
gaps.closure_evidence: Per-source digest, applicable clause/section and licensed archival reference.

gaps.scope: rate, quota, page, payload, concurrency, retention, cursor TTL, timeout, egress and license
gaps.gap: A provider-neutral class cannot truthfully publish a numerical deployment limit.
gaps.closure_evidence: Each source occurrence records probed values, scope, unit, provenance, observation time and failure behavior.

gaps.gap: Regional banking, tax, customs, defense, election, mining, agriculture, nuclear, semiconductor and proprietary instrument profiles remain intentionally extensible rather than exhaustively hard-coded.
gaps.closure_evidence: Recurring industry-pack audits yield no new capability semantics; newly observed semantics add classes or profiles without compiler name branches.

gaps.gap: The class universe distinguishes semantic capability, not every protocol or serialization; protocol/provider coverage lives in adapters and may reveal a new class gap.
gaps.closure_evidence: Protocol corpus maps every observed variant to existing surfaces or a typed extension record.

gaps.scope: LLM, prompt, RAG and agent-memory systems
gaps.gap: The core treats model artifacts and telemetry generically and deliberately does not embed LLM-specific meaning.
gaps.closure_evidence: A separately namespaced extension with one-way dependency on core source contracts, dedicated privacy/security tests and no core compiler dependency.

gaps.gap: A finite list of 171 candidate classes does not prove complete coverage of future or obscure source behavior.
gaps.closure_evidence: Repeated independent audits across unrelated industries and deployments yield only occurrence/adapter additions and no unowned semantic capability.
